description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class 'ImmutableAdaptable' which implements the 'Adaptable' interface. It defines methods to create and access properties like 'topicPath', 'payload', and 'headers' and manages header information, providing immutable behavior.

classes.name: ImmutableAdaptable
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Adaptable interface, providing access to topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableAdaptable instance with specified topicPath, payload, and headers.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the topic path associated with this adaptable.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload associated with this adaptable.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing headers if present.

methods.name: containsHeaderForKey
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified key exists.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the given DittoHeaders.
